command.text: Choices: single adult Sam, age 42, BC, 2026, salary CAD 64,000; dependants ages 10 and 14 recorded in brief but app household setup had no dependant field. January 1 assets: bank 2,200, TFSA 1,000, RRSP 9,000. Kept default 2.5% pay growth with inflation, 2.5% inflation, 7% return, shared retirement at 65 (2049); standard salary-based CPP/QPP and OAS age 65 because no benefit estimates supplied. Added rent 1,600, groceries 900, debt payment 300, transport 350, children 500, utilities 250, clothing/household 400 = 4,300 monthly including the debt payment. Entered approximate 5,000 TFSA and RRSP room solely to test room handling; real room must be checked with CRA. Salary gross monthly arithmetic is 64,000/12=5,333; Salary estimated annual take-home 50,386 / 12 = 4,199 rounded. Current take-home 50,386 is below 51,600 expenses. Debt payment is only an expense; I found no card balance, rate, principal split or payoff tracking. More says child benefits are not modeled automatically and known after-tax amounts can be added in Year; none supplied, so none entered. Tried Salary edit and February income/expense override form, canceled without altering values. Closed Jan 2026 and saved lesson; lesson survived reload. Export/import round-trip succeeded and the backup file is retained. Remaining untested: actual CRA room and benefit entitlements, tax accuracy, payoff math, and month override save behavior.
